title: Rich Slow-Braised Garlic & Herb Pork Stew
originalTitle: Rich Slow-Braised Garlic & Herb Pork Stew
ingredients: 2.5 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1.5-inch cubes
3 carrots, cut into thick coins & 2 stalks celery, chopped
2 tbsp tomato paste & 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
1 cup dry red wine or dark beer + 3 cups beef or chicken stock
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 2 sprigs rosemary, 3 sprigs thyme, 2 bay leaves
instructions: Season pork shoulder cubes generously with salt and pepper and sear in batches in a hot Dutch oven with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned on all sides.
Sauté onion, carrots, celery, and garlic in the pork drippings for 5 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and flour and cook 2 minutes.
Deglaze with red wine, scraping up all browned bits, then add stock, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, herbs, and seared pork.
Cover and simmer on low (or braise in a 325°F oven) for 75–90 minutes, adding the cubed Yukon Gold potatoes for the final 30 minutes until meltingly tender.
